standing: transcription of candidate-public declarations; not protocol adoption

recordIdentity.preimage: abi.encode(bytes32 domain, bytes32 typeId, bytes32 bodyHash)

subjectIdentity.preimage: abi.encode(bytes32 domain, bytes32 principalId, bytes32 salt)
subjectIdentity.limitation: principalId must be supplied as raw bytes32; address-to-principal derivation is not declared

actionCommitment.reason: public manifest does not declare ordered Action fields, ABI types, array framing, or action type string

signedDigest.reason: public manifest names EIP-712 PublicationIntent and domain name/version but omits the complete domain field set, ordered intent fields, types, and action/body commitment framing

signatureRecovery.scope: ECDSA recovery for a supplied bytes32 digest and signature only; this does not establish candidate signed-plan binding
